checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that most structural checkpoints (windows, interior, door) are untestable due to the tight crop. However, the Router was too lenient in marking 'Breads pastries and cakes visible in display' as PRESENT. The checkpoint implies actual baked goods in a display case; the image only shows a decorative, likely AI-hallucinated cutout of a loaf. This is a semantic mismatch. The 'Sign with bakery name' checkpoint is partially present but marred by gibberish, which the Router noted but didn't penalize in the verdict itself.
artifact_review: The Router's severity ratings for text gibberish (2) and structural collapse (3) are accurate. The Image Text Auditor failed to extract any text, confirming the 'gibberish' nature of the upper sign text and potentially the main sign if it were less clear. The Topology Auditor found a high-confidence mask for the bread cutout, but this does not rule out the visual fusion/melting observed by the Router. The Fine Grained Classifier's failure to identify the image as a 'bakery' (predicting 'pay-phone' instead) is a critical signal that the visual features are insufficient or misleading, supporting the presence of significant artifacts or poor generation quality.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails to convincingly represent the 'bakery' class beyond a single sign. The Fine Grained Classifier's top prediction of 'pay-phone' indicates a severe semantic ambiguity or failure. While the sign says 'Brimmer & Co', the lack of other bakery cues (windows, products) and the presence of AI artifacts reduce alignment significantly. Only 1 of 9 checkpoints is fully testable and present (Sign), and even that is flawed.
artifact_reasoning: Multiple artifacts detected: 1) Text gibberish on the sign (confirmed by Text Auditor's empty output). 2) Structural fusion/melting of the decorative bread cutout into the beam (Router observation). 3) Perspective distortion on the awning. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these structural issues, but the Router and Text/Classifier experts provide strong evidence of defects.
key_defects: Semantic misclassification by expert (Pay-phone vs Bakery)
Lack of defining bakery features (windows, products) due to crop/generation
